name: Amanita muscaria

ecology.hosts: birch, pine, spruce; eucalypt and southern beech where introduced

size_cm.source: Kuo M 2013, Amanita muscaria var. flavivolvata, MushroomExpert.Com
size_cm.note: cap 5 to 25 cm; stem 5 to 18 cm long and 1 to 3 cm thick. Described from the North American variety flavivolvata

notes: Medium-distance smooth exploration type at genus level [13]. Native to NA, EU and AS; invasive in AU, SA and AF, where it is reported (unchecked) to be spreading with planted pines; genome reported (unchecked).

tip_speed.note: 0.43 +/- 0.04 mm/day for control cultures on MMN agar at 20 C over 9 weeks (0.58 mm/day beside the helper bacterium Streptomyces AcH 505): Schrey SD, Salo V, Raudaskoski M, Hampp R, Nehls U, Tarkka MT 2007, Current Genetics 52:77-85 (https://doi.org/10.1007/s00294-007-0138-x). The number was read from a search snippet of the full text; only the abstract, which has no numbers, could be opened. 0.43 x 41.7 = 18 um/h. Measured at 20 C; the optimum temperature is not known, so no correction was made

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
